questions.stem: An L-shaped figure is made of two rectangles: one $8$ cm $\times$ $3$ cm and one $5$ cm $\times$ $4$ cm. What is its total area?
A rectangular lawn is $10$ m $\times$ $6$ m with a $2$ m $\times$ $2$ m square flower bed removed from the centre. What is the remaining area of lawn?
Which method is used to find the area of a compound shape?

options.text: Multiply all the side lengths together
Split into simpler shapes, find each area, then add (or subtract)
Find the perimeter and divide by $2$
Use a single formula for the whole shape

questions.explanation: A compound shape is split into simpler shapes (rectangles, triangles, etc.), and the individual areas are added together or subtracted.

questions.stem: A T-shaped figure is made of a $10$ cm $\times$ $2$ cm rectangle on top and a $2$ cm $\times$ $6$ cm rectangle below. What is the total area?
A shape consists of a rectangle $12$ cm $\times$ $8$ cm with a right-angled triangle of base $4$ cm and height $8$ cm attached to one end. What is the total area?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area $= 12 \times 8 = 96$ cm$^2$. Triangle area $= \frac{1}{2} \times 4 \times 8 = 16$ cm$^2$. Total $= 96 + 16 = 112$ cm$^2$.

questions.stem: A $6$ cm $\times$ $6$ cm square has a triangle of base $6$ cm and height $4$ cm cut from one side. What is the remaining area?
questions.explanation: Square area $= 36$ cm$^2$. Triangle area $= \frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 4 = 12$ cm$^2$. Remaining $= 36 - 12 = 24$ cm$^2$.

questions.stem: A compound shape is made by joining a semicircle of diameter $10$ cm to a rectangle of $10$ cm $\times$ $6$ cm. What is the total area? (Use $\pi \approx 3.14$)
questions.explanation: Rectangle $= 10 \times 6 = 60$ cm$^2$. Semicircle $= \frac{1}{2}\pi r^2 = \frac{1}{2} \times 3.14 \times 5^2 = 39.25$ cm$^2$. Total $\approx 60 + 39.3 = 99.3$ cm$^2$.
